limits.scope: Compare matched optimized configurations and workloads: 10 gestures per widget cohort and 30 pointer motions/button edges. Development measurements, not qualification.
limits.explanation: 20.1 ms allows one PAL scanout-observation frame of phase difference. CPU/consumption budgets are explicit integration allowances, not measured jitter. No deliberate extra-frame wait is allowed. Exceedances require investigation before AS4 acceptance.

methodology: Ten gestures / twenty button edges per idle, scroll and disk cohort; thirty motions and thirty independently observed edges per quiet pointer cohort.

Pointer measurements use the same raw-event window and unchanged keyboard preflight as frozen AS0, with the production panel and quiet application. Widget and raw-event window configurations are not interchangeable.
C fixture assertion counters are private to each Task. Successful checks add no Forbid/Permit calls; all original assertions and GEM traffic remain.

Call distributions use settled 100-frame idle, scroll and disk windows. Disk warm-up completes mount/open and the first read. The observed proof traces presenter turns during GUI lock phases, then disables instruction history for state/progress checks. Optional --trace-calls retains whole-run IPC observation.
Passive emitted markers separate submission, service admission, public ReplyMsg invocation and checked client return. Deadline measurements exclude requested duration and VBI rounding.

The bounded GUI repaint gets its existing quantum ahead of new console work; input is captured at active boundaries. Ready paint continues within the preemptive Task quantum without an extra voluntary Yield; blocked work still waits on signals.
Button pixels use an exact oracle and sampled pre/post-colour checks. Combined feedback is an upper bound because label observation follows the button scanout.
open_gates: AS4 relative latency acceptance remains open; every frozen/matched exceedance is retained in comparison.
Existing absolute widget latency targets remain open.
125 kbit/s SIO timing remains open; this record uses the pinned nominal 57.6k configuration.
GEM windows, WM_REDRAW, visible rectangles, independent VDI workstations, resources/forms/menus, discovery/loading and forced recovery remain follow-on work.
Development checks do not qualify a hosted release or hardware. The standard OF816 demo package was not refreshed.
